source: GitHub Actions · Yahoo daily bars (after the close) · Nifty 200 (NSE) + F&O lots (NSE)

strategies.name: Pullback to 20 EMA
rules: Entry: the app's "Pullback to 20 EMA in uptrend" signal on a daily close (Nifty 200 + F&O stocks). Order placed for the next session.
Fill: at the next open if the planned entry is within ¼ ATR of the close, otherwise a buy-stop (above) or buy-limit (below) order valid for 3 sessions.
Stop and target: the levels the app shows for the setup. Half exits at Target 1, stop moves to entry, the rest rides to Target 2 (2× the first target distance).
Time exit: at the close after 10 sessions.
Size: risk ₹1,000 per trade (1% of ₹1 lakh), max ₹25,000 per position, cash only.

strategies.name: Swing rating ≥70
rules: Entry: the app's Swing rating (same number as the stock page) is 70 or more at the daily close. Buy at the next open; highest ratings first.
Stop / Target 1 / Target 2: the Swing plan levels (1.5 ATR stop or recent swing low; T1 1.5R, T2 3R). Half at T1, stop to entry.
Time exit: 10 sessions.
Size: ₹1,000 risk, max ₹25,000 per position.

strategies.name: Short-term rating ≥70
rules: Entry: Short-term (2–6 weeks) rating ≥70 at the close; buy at the next open.
Levels: the Short-term plan (2.5 ATR / 20-day swing low stop, T1 1.5R, T2 3R). Half at T1, stop to entry.
Time exit: 30 sessions.
Size: ₹1,000 risk, max ₹25,000 per position.

strategies.name: Medium-term rating ≥75
rules: Entry: Medium-term (2–6 months) rating ≥75 at the close; buy at the next open.
Levels: the Medium plan (4 ATR / 60-day swing low stop, T1 1.5R, T2 3R). Half at T1, stop to entry.
Time exit: 60 sessions (the paper league reviews faster than the 2–6 month horizon).
Size: ₹1,000 risk, max ₹25,000 per position.

strategies.name: EMA 20/50 bullish cross
rules: Entry: the 20 EMA crosses above the 50 EMA today and the close is above the 200 EMA. Buy at the next open.
Stop: 2 ATR below the entry. Target 1: 2 ATR above, Target 2: 4 ATR above. Half at T1, stop to entry.
Also exits at the close if the 20 EMA crosses back below the 50 EMA. Time exit 40 sessions.
Size: ₹1,000 risk, max ₹25,000 per position.

strategies.name: Best-of league: equity
rules: The self-improving strategy: each day it takes the signals of the strategies that are PROMOTED at the latest weekly review (best score first, max 3 a day).
Each trade keeps the source strategy's rules (entry, stop, targets, time exit).
If nothing is promoted it stays in cash. Its result shows whether picking strategies by their track record actually adds value.
Size: ₹1,000 risk, max ₹25,000 per position.

strategies.name: Benchmark: Nifty 50 buy & hold
rules: Buys ₹1 lakh of the Nifty 50 index (like an index ETF) at the open of the first day and never sells.
Costs: one delivery buy. Dividends are ignored (Yahoo index prices exclude them).
Not ranked: it is the bar every equity strategy should beat.

strategies.name: Index options: app pick (CE/PE)
rules: Underlyings: NIFTY, BANKNIFTY, SENSEX. At the close the app's call/put rating is computed exactly like the F&O tab (market closed: 30% intraday + 70% swing).
Entry: buy a CE if the CALL side is 65+, a PE if the PUT side is 65+, at the next open. Strike chosen like the app: ATM, or 1 strike OTM when the rating is 78+ and Target 1 lies beyond it.
Expiry: nearest expiry with at least 2 sessions left (NIFTY weekly Tue, SENSEX weekly Thu, BANKNIFTY monthly last Tue).
Exit: underlying hits the swing Stop (or the premium halves) → out; underlying hits Target 1 → half out, rest at Target 2; else out at the close after 3 sessions or the day before expiry.
Size: lots so that a 50% premium loss ≈ ₹10,000 (1% of ₹10 lakh); premium outlay ≤ ₹2 lakh. Premiums are SIMULATED (Black-Scholes on India VIX).

strategies.name: Index options: always 1 strike ITM
rules: Same signal, expiry, exits and sizing as "app pick", but always buys the strike one step in the money (higher delta, less time decay).
Premiums are SIMULATED (Black-Scholes on India VIX).

strategies.name: Index options: always 1 strike OTM
rules: Same signal, expiry, exits and sizing as "app pick", but always buys the strike one step out of the money (cheaper, more leverage, more decay).
Premiums are SIMULATED (Black-Scholes on India VIX).

strategies.name: Stock futures: swing rating long/short
rules: Universe: F&O stocks. Long the near-month future when the Swing rating is ≥70, short it when ≤30 (shorting allowed in futures). Next-open entry, strongest first.
Levels: the Swing plan (stop, T1 1.5R, T2 3R). Half at T1 when 2+ lots, stop to entry. Time exit 10 sessions.

Size: ₹20 lakh paper account (one stock-futures lot is ₹15 lakh+). Lots so the stop risks ≈ ₹40,000 (2%), max 3; skipped if one lot risks more than ₹60,000. Margin ≈ 20% of contract value must fit the account.
Futures priced at the stock's cash price (basis/rollover not modelled).

strategies.name: Stock futures: overall rating long/short
rules: Same as the swing futures strategy but triggered by the overall stock rating (swing to long blend, the big number on the stock page) ≥70 long / ≤30 short.
Swing plan levels (stop, T1 1.5R, T2 3R). Time exit 15 sessions.
Futures priced at the stock's cash price (basis/rollover not modelled).

strategies.name: NIFTY weekly iron condor (hedged selling)
rules: When NIFTY has no trend (Swing score 43–57) and no condor is open: at the next open sell the call and put about 1 expected move (VIX-based) away and buy wings 200 points further out (defined risk). Expiry: nearest weekly with 2+ sessions left.
Exit at the close if the loss reaches 1.5× the credit or 50% of the credit is captured; otherwise held to expiry and settled at the closing index level.
Size: lots so the maximum loss ≈ ₹10,000–₹20,000. Checks happen on daily closes only: intraday spikes are not modelled, so real losses can be larger.
Premiums are SIMULATED (Black-Scholes on India VIX with put skew).

strategies.name: Best-of league: F&O
rules: Each day takes the signals of the F&O strategies PROMOTED at the latest weekly review (max 2 a day), with the source strategy's rules.
Stays flat if none is promoted.

notes: Paper trades only: no real orders. Fills use daily bars: next-open entries, stop-first when a day touches both stop and target, gaps through a stop fill at the open.
F&O premiums are SIMULATED with Black-Scholes using India VIX (with a per-index multiplier and put skew). Real premiums, spreads and IV can differ a lot.

Backfilled trades replay past sessions walk-forward (each signal uses only data up to that day), but the strategy rules and the rating model were designed with knowledge of that period. Treat them as a rough start; only live-forward results are a fair test.
Costs include brokerage, STT, exchange, SEBI, stamp duty, GST and slippage. Past results do not guarantee future returns.
